outcome: intrapartum fetal acidemia (fetal lactate concentration >4.8 mmol/L at fetal scalp blood sampling)
cohort: 507 fetuses with predominantly variable decelerations as the indication for fetal scalp blood sampling from a source population of 1070 labors at Karolinska University Hospital, Sweden.
finding: Deceleration area and duration were better predictors of intrapartum fetal acidemia than deceleration depth, with cumulative deceleration area >250 beats during 30 min associated with three-fold higher odds of acidemia.
cross-section timing: Last 60- and 30-minutes of fetal monitoring preceding fetal scalp blood sampling
